scope: Static keyboard, browser-prerequisite, zoom/reflow acceptance audit for feature-frozen Reeris Core

environment.runtimeNote: This audit is static. The build container Chromium process is not a substitute for the published desktop/mobile browser matrix; interactive verification remains a manual/release-lab gate.

nowrapDeclarations.text: :where(.app-shell[data-reeris-state="collapsed"] .app-sidebar-label) { position:absolute; inline-size:1px; block-size:1px; padding:0; margin:-1px; overflow:hidden; clip:rect(0,0,0,0); white-space:nowrap; border:0; }
:where(.table.stack thead) { position:absolute; inline-size:1px; block-size:1px; overflow:hidden; clip-path:inset(50%); white-space:nowrap; }

checks.detail: Global :focus-visible indicator is present.
Core CSS does not suppress focus outlines.
Hover-card content opens for keyboard focus as well as pointer hover.
Drop-zone highlight has a focus-within path.
Optional glide navigation follows keyboard focus.
Glide pointer enhancement avoids relying on touch hover.
ARIA-disabled controls are not pointer-only disabled in CSS.
Documentation exercises native details/summary disclosure patterns.
Documentation exercises native dialog semantics.
Documentation does not depend on inline event handlers.
Documentation does not model generic div/span button or link roles.
Browser text-size adjustment is not disabled.
Long prose/table content has a global overflow-wrap safety net.
Buttons may grow and wrap long/translated labels.
Input groups can shrink inside narrow containers.
Input addons wrap instead of forcing horizontal overflow.
Dialog width is capped to the logical viewport.
Drawers use logical/dynamic viewport constraints.
Mega-menu width is capped to the logical viewport.
Hover-card width is capped to the logical viewport.
Command palette width is capped to the logical viewport.
Identity text wraps instead of being permanently ellipsized.
File names can wrap at narrow widths.
Tree labels can wrap at narrow widths.
Inbox/message text unwraps in narrow containers.
Application title can wrap rather than clip.
Wide semantic tables have an explicit scrolling fallback.
Tables provide an opt-in container-aware stacked presentation.
Core does not use physical 100vw sizing that can induce scrollbar overflow.
Core uses dynamic/logical viewport units rather than 100vh.
Core does not globally hide horizontal overflow.
Viewport breakpoints are not hard-coded in px.
Core contains broad container-query coverage for component reflow.
9 nowrap declarations found; 9 match the intentional allowlist.
Logical properties are used for direction-independent layout.
Progressive browser features are protected with @supports.
Forced-colors adaptations are present.
Reduced-motion adaptations are present.
At least one touch/no-hover capability adaptation is present.
Safe-area insets are exposed/used for mobile browser UI.
Print fallback rules are present.

manualGate: Keyboard-only traversal: Tab/Shift+Tab, Enter/Space, Escape, native details/dialog/popover behavior, visible focus, no focus traps outside modals.

Zoom/reflow at 200% and 400% at a 1280 CSS-pixel desktop baseline and narrow mobile widths; verify no loss of content/functionality and no two-dimensional scrolling except data tables or intentionally scrollable regions.
Safari macOS/iOS/iPadOS, Chrome/Edge/Firefox desktop, Chrome Android using the release-specific tested version matrix.
Touch target and gesture review on physical/mobile emulation, including fixed bottom navigation and drawers.
RTL plus long translated strings at 200%/400% zoom.
Screen-reader pass for dynamic overlays, menus, validation, loading and transient feedback.
